propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, respecting effective disables, project applicability, and explicit budgets instead of unconditionally applying Round-A fan-in and packaged-only overlays.

Project LLM criteria must select by effective globs; disabled or non-applicable criteria execute zero times with stored reason provenance; project DET criteria execute through detector selector outside the LLM fan-in.

After one local criterion call fails, later independent criteria must execute and retain earlier successes; missing blocking-capable coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists, and advisory-only missing coverage may pass.
Positive authored usd_budget must be enforced and shed units recorded; zero is schema-invalid; every call is accounted for with no implicit cap.
Versioned safe discovery trace must persist in internal code-review journal sidecar, never in normal review response or status projection.

Authored code-review.yaml topology, base-reviewer summary/recommendations, per-overlay context overrides, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints are preserved; public response shape remains backward-compatible.
